as_told.title: Government has held secret physics since the end of World War II

plain: This story is the idea that the US government has secretly been doing research into the basic laws of physics since around the end of the Second World War, and has kept the results hidden. A researcher named Matthew Pines says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that it is very clear to him that the government has been doing this. A second person, James Valor, who works with a startup called Skywatcher that tries to attract UFOs, says much the same on the same podcast. Valor says he agrees with the thinker Eric Weinstein that the government has top secret physics knowledge, and that it has probably had it since at least the end of the war. Both present this as their own view rather than as something a source told them. If true, it would mean some of the most important science of the past 80 years has been kept from the public.
